_comment: Example infrastructure.json - Base configuration merged with environment-specific files
name: ActionReady - {layer} [{environment}]

generic._capacity_note: Fabric capacity name (must exist in tenant). Base value = NON-PRODUCTION capacity (dev, tst and feature workspaces); infrastructure.prd.json overrides it with the production capacity. Production and non-production run on separate capacities (D-596).

surge_protection._surge_note: Workspace-level surge protection (preview). The workspace CU limit is one percentage per capacity (rolling 24 h) and applies to every workspace on it that is 'Available'; prd workspaces are 'Mission critical' (fabric_setup.py SURGE_CLASS_BY_ENVIRONMENT). null = not yet set by the capacity admin; no documented API, set in OneLake catalog > Govern > Capacities.

permissions._permissions_note: Workspace role assignments. Types: Group, User, ServicePrincipal

fabric_connections._connection_note: Fabric connections created and assigned to workspaces
fabric_connections.name: Connection-DataPipeline [{environment}]

layers._layers_note: Workspace layers: DE (Data Engineering), DM (Data Models), BI (Reporting), Shared

Lakehouse._skip_note: If true, workspace created but item not created
